name: eco-tashkent
description: Eco Tashkent — shahar ekologiyasi va buyumlar almashinuvi ekotizimi (Web + API + Telegram Bot)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix bot
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,bot -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix bot"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend,bot -c green,cyan,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend" "npm start --prefix bot"
